about: Room 1 only. One node: NN1-fly chooses the move on every tick, from any FLYABLE Room 1 cell to the flyable cell nearest the doorway, and stays there. The doorway is never entered. Flyable = the cells and legs the Neo 2 host's own 0.60 m clearance test accepts at 1.55 m (grid/room1_flyable.json).

flight.about: the start cell holds the Neo 2 pad (E 1.47, N 0.64: 28 cm from floor tag 60 toward wall tag 15, nose at wall tag 36), LAB_HOWTO.md section 5; 1.55 m and 0.60 m are the altitude and margin grid/room1_flyable.json was computed at, which the host checks again in the air
